Accordion

Accordions stack expandable sections vertically. By default only one panel is open at a time; use data-zak-accordion="multi" to allow several open at once.

Basic Accordion

Structure: .zak-accordion > .zak-accordion-item > .zak-accordion-trigger + .zak-accordion-body. Mark an open item with .zak-accordion-item-active.

ZAKUIKit is a design system and component library with semantic classes and a dependency-free JavaScript engine included in dist/js/zak.js.
Drop dist/css/zak.css and dist/js/zak.js into the page; components auto-bind from their data attributes when zak.init() runs.
Yes. The CSS classes are framework-agnostic; you can bind the toggle behavior yourself or call the same JS methods from lifecycle hooks.
HTML
<div class="zak-accordion" data-zak-accordion>
    <div class="zak-accordion-item zak-accordion-item-active">
        <button class="zak-accordion-trigger" type="button">
            What is ZAKUIKit?
            <svg class="zak-accordion-icon" ...></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="zak-accordion-body">...answer text...</div>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-accordion-item">...</div>
</div>

Accordion with Icon

Drop a .zak-accordion-icon inside any trigger; it rotates 180° while its panel is open.

Run the linter and type checker before merging. Prefer small, single-purpose components and keep logic close to the markup it styles.

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
/* Class Summary */
.zak-accordion          /* Vertical stack of items */
.zak-accordion-item     /* Single section */
.zak-accordion-item-active /* Open section */
.zak-accordion-trigger  /* Toggling button */
.zak-accordion-icon     /* Rotating chevron */
.zak-accordion-body     /* Collapsible content region */

/* Variables used */
--zak-border            /* Item borders */
--zak-surface           /* Item background */
--zak-radius-md         /* Rounded corners */
--zak-transition-medium /* Icon/height animation */

JavaScript

HTML
// Data attributes (automatic)
//   data-zak-accordion        exclusive (one open at a time)
//   data-zak-accordion="multi"  multiple panels open

// Programmatic API
zak.accordion.open(itemEl);
zak.accordion.close(itemEl);

// Events fire on the item element
item.addEventListener('zak:open', function () {});
item.addEventListener('zak:close', function () {});

// Single panels outside an accordion can also use
// the Collapse component for the same animation.

Accessibility

  • Each trigger is a real <button> with aria-expanded toggled by the framework.
  • The body region is linked to its trigger with aria-controls and labelled via aria-labelledby.
  • Enter/Space toggle a focused panel; the single-on behavior follows the WAI-ARIA accordion pattern.
  • Keep the trigger text short and descriptive — it is what screen readers announce first.
  • Avoid placing focusable controls in collapsed bodies; give open panels a heading structure.
